As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return tomorrow on Apple TV, with a host of related features rolling out simultaneously across Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+, and other platforms. Details as follows.

MLS Returns on Apple TV

Apple today placed a major focus on promoting the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs. Toronto FC (7:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Chicago Fire vs. Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • St. Louis City SC vs. Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Seattle Sounders FC vs. Portland Timbers (10:30 PM Eastern Time)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs. Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM Eastern Time)
  • LA Galaxy vs. LAFC (10:15 PM Eastern Time)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a range of MLS-themed features coming to its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

A new episode features German football legend Thomas Müller, who "reflects on the hard work he put in before his career took off, and shares how he embraces the challenge of life's major transitions."

Apple Music will also launch a number of exclusive playlists curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake, Evander Da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, as well as playlists themed around various clubs from both the East and West, including the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple is rolling out "matchday guides created by MLS clubs and city tours put together by the players themselves, helping users discover restaurants for game day, explore the city's hot spots, and learn more about the stadiums."

Users who rely on the Apple Sports app can stay on top of league action with live scores, standings, play-by-play updates, formation lineups and team stats.

Finally, Apple noted:

MLS matches are available to Apple TV subscribers free of charge in more than 100 countries and territories worldwide, with Apple also providing exclusive content, plus access to all the season's cup competitions and the playoffs.

For more of Apple's coverage of the MLS return, click this link.

Apple TV is priced at US$12.99 per month, or via an Apple One bundle subscription. The platform offers a wide range of hit series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
